tools.name: generate_shift_schedule
tools.description: Use this when the user wants an employee schedule maker or work schedule maker: build a weekly staff or shift schedule for a restaurant, cafe, retail store, clinic front desk or similar from staff names, roles or skills, availability (days or times people cannot work), min/max hours, and the shifts

tools.name: check_schedule
tools.description: Use this when the user already has a work schedule and wants it checked against scheduling rules: "check this schedule", "does anyone have a clopening", "is anyone over 40 hours", "fix this schedule, Sam cannot work Mondays". Takes the shifts with the people on them (typed, or an attached schedule C

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: generate_shift_schedule · Private data: generate_shift_schedule, check_schedule · Public sink: generate_shift_schedule · Destructive: generate_shift_schedule.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: generate_shift_schedule · Private data: generate_shift_schedule, check_schedule · Public sink: generate_shift_schedule · Destructive: generate_shift_schedule

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
